description.value: The Powell River Public Library is a full-service public library on the Sunshine Coast offering books, digital resources, and community programs including 3D printing and a 'Library of Things' lending collection. It serves as a cultural and community hub on Tla'amin Nation traditional territory. Touring cyclists passing through Powell River can use its free internet and computer services.

address.value: 100-6975 Alberni Street, Powell River BC V8A 2B8

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at prpl.ca confirms the OSM contact details (phone, address, website) exactly. The site lists 'Computer & Internet Use' as a service and OSM tags internet_access=wlan, together confirming Wi-Fi. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, so those remain null.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The library is a legitimate public facility with confirmed Wi-Fi, but none of the required cycling amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water refill) are confirmed from the website. Warrants human review to verify on-site cyclist facilities before listing.

blurb: Powell River's library with 3D printing and Library of Things.
